name: Repair Rat PostgreSQL transaction reference pack
policy: Architecture guidance only. No implementation source is copied.

sources.name: PostgreSQL Serialization Failure Handling
invariants: Retry complete transactions after SQLSTATE 40001 serialization_failure.
40P01 deadlock_detected can be a bounded retry candidate.
A retry reruns complete transaction logic from the beginning.

sources.name: PostgreSQL Error Codes
invariants: 40003 = statement_completion_unknown; do not blind-replay unknown completion.

sources.name: node-postgres Transactions
invariants: All statements of a transaction use the same checked-out client.
Do not use pool.query for statements inside one transaction.

sources.name: Slonik transaction retrying
invariants: Retry by rerunning the transaction callback after rollback-class failure.
The callback is the retry unit, not one failed statement.

siteboss_required_constraints: Retry only a complete fresh transaction attempt.
Default retry candidates in this repair scope are 40001 and 40P01.
Do not blindly retry ambiguous completion or commit outcomes.
Do not duplicate external/non-transactional side effects.
Preserve tenant isolation and exact-once/idempotency semantics.
Bound retry count and any backoff/jitter.
